top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature, enduring, and consequential account of how collateral and financial conditions amplify macroeconomic fluctuations. Its citation can remain narrow enough to acknowledge the distinct Kiyotaki-Moore and Gertler lineages while crediting their shared foundational contribution.
recusal_note: I am an IIES colleague and frequent coauthor of committee secretary Per Krusell; he is not a proposed laureate, and no candidate-specific connection to the proposed P001 laureates is apparent from the supplied evidence.
